tex_content.html:
Proposition
↗ lem:connections-from-connection-coefficients 1. ch4:4.12

Every smooth manifold with or without boundary admits a connection on its tangent bundle.
Proof

\sketch Choose local connections $ abla ^\alpha $ on a coordinate cover and a subordinate partition of unity $(\varphi _\alpha )$. Set

egin{equation} abla _XY=\sum _\alpha \varphi _\alpha abla _X^\alpha Y. ag {4.11} \end{equation}

Local finiteness gives smoothness. The partition identity $\sum _\alpha \varphi _\alpha =1$ yields

\[ abla _X(fY)=\sum _\alpha \varphi _\alpha ((Xf)Y+f abla _X^\alpha Y)=(Xf)Y+f abla _XY. \]

□
